title: Quality review body
description: One reviewer's rubric scores for a delivery (register row JO8; spec-delta S1704). Work that cannot be checked by a command (writing, design, research) is judged against the intent's own acceptance criteria, each scored from 0 to 10 by at most seven reviewers who are neither the principal nor the performer; the log reports the median and the spread of each criterion and how far each reviewer sits from the panel. The record is advice to the principal's acceptance and to a Court: it settles nothing and moves no credits. The delivery must be in this log for the contract (quality_review_unknown_delivery); the contract is not yet settled (quality_review_too_late); the reviewer has a passport and is not a party (quality_review_unknown_reviewer, quality_review_party); every criterion is scored once, in range (quality_review_items); one review a reviewer for a delivery (quality_review_known); at most seven (quality_review_panel_full). Subject: the contract. Chain: none (prev is null).

criterion.description: The index of the acceptance criterion in the intent the contract rests on (0 when it rests on none: the whole purpose is one criterion).
